interface.title: 医析台 MedBench (v1.3, local Streamlit app)
interface.field: Clinical research biostatistics and hospital quality control
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis of collected study data, from cleaning through modelling to a write-up ready for a manuscript; separately, routine monitoring of department quality indicators
interface.what_it_is_for: A Chinese-language workbench where a clinical researcher loads an Excel study table, checks and cleans it, runs descriptive, inferential, predictive, survival and causal analyses, and exports chosen results as a Word, Excel or figure-pack report with an auto-drafted methods paragraph. Department quality-control staff can also use it on its own to chart indicators over time.

data.note: I loaded the 300-case demo with the sidebar button '🎯 加载示例数据（300例）'. It has 300 rows and 20 variables (age, sex, BMI, blood pressure, lab values, clinical stage, treatment group, length of stay, recovery, pain score, follow-up months, event), with 1.87% of cells missing (112). The app first rendered blank for about 30 s and appeared after reloading on localhost. Every matplotlib figure draws its Chinese titles, axis labels and legends as empty boxes because the server has no CJK font; numbers and Latin text show normally. Several variable pairings below were chosen only to exercise the controls on this demo table and are not meaningful analyses (marked 'UI demonstration only').

tree.general: Analyse a clinical dataset, either taking a study from raw table to a reportable statistical analysis or monitoring a quality indicator over time
tree.specific: Load the 300-case demo into MedBench; on the manuscript path clean it, describe it, test it, model it, run causal analyses and export a Word report; on the separate quality-control path draw an SPC chart
tree.branch: one-of: manuscript analysis pipeline / department quality-control monitoring (both start from the loaded data)

features.name: Rule-based dataset profiler with analysis recommender
features.general: Load a table, let the tool classify each column's role (identifier, time, grouping, outcome, numeric), check per-column quality, and get a list of analyses the data can support, each with its reason
features.specific: 总览与洞察: metric cards, the 识别到的结构 role table with its criteria, the 推荐分析 list (its 打开 → buttons did not navigate in the replay), and the 字段元数据 expander showing missing %, unique values and outlier counts per field
steps: read the summary cards and the detected-structure table
read the recommended analyses and their reasons, then open the matching tab yourself
serves_tasks: Review automatically detected variable roles and suggested analyses
Inspect per-variable missingness, distinct values and outliers

features.name: Missing-data pattern viewer with MICE imputation
features.general: See which variables are missing and which go missing together, pick a handling strategy, run multiple imputation with chosen number of datasets and iterations, read pooled estimates, then either add them to the report or replace the working data
features.specific: 🩹 缺失模式与多重插补: missing-rate table, co-missing pattern table, bar chart and heatmap; the 处理方式 radio (不处理 / 单值填补 / MICE); sliders for m and iterations; Rubin-pooled mean table; 加入报告 and 把第 1 份插补结果设为当前数据
steps: open the expander and read the pattern tables and plots
set m and iterations with the sliders
run MICE and read the pooled means with 95% CI
add to the report or set an imputed dataset as current
serves_tasks: Fill in missing values by multiple imputation

features.name: Filtered extract with de-identified export
features.general: Choose columns, filter rows by a field and keyword, cap the row count, set how each sensitive column is masked, preview the masked rows and download a CSV
features.specific: 当前数据（查看 / 筛选 / 导出）: 摘录字段 multiselect, 筛选字段 + 关键词, 最多摘录行数, an editable grid, the 🔒 脱敏设置 per-field strategy (e.g. 假名（稳定哈希）), 👁️ 预览脱敏结果 and 📥 下载摘录 CSV（已脱敏）
steps: set a filter field and type a keyword
set the masking strategy for each detected identifier
serves_tasks: Filter, view and export a de-identified extract of the data

features.name: Single-variable distribution card with normality-driven method advice
features.general: Pick a numeric variable and an optional grouping, get n, mean±SD, median (IQR), a normality verdict and a recommended summary statistic and test, along with histogram+KDE, Q-Q and grouped box plots that can be sent to the report
features.specific: 描述性分析 → 数值变量: 选择数值变量 and 按变量分组 selects, four metric cards, the 💡 方法推荐 banner, 分布可视化 (three figures) and 📥 加入报告
steps: read the normality verdict and the recommended method
inspect the histogram, Q-Q plot and boxplot
add the three plots to the report
serves_tasks: Summarise a continuous variable, test normality and get a method recommendation
Plot the distribution, overall and by group

features.name: Auto-selecting group comparison test
features.general: Pick an outcome and a grouping variable; the tool chooses the right test (t / Mann-Whitney / ANOVA / Kruskal-Wallis for numeric outcomes, chi-square for categorical ones) from normality and group count, and reports the statistic, p, significance, effect size and per-group summaries
features.specific: 统计推断 → 数值变量 × 分组 / 分类变量 × 分组: result cards (检验方法, 统计量, p 值, 显著性), 效应量 banner (ε², Cramér's V), 分组统计 or 列联表 table, and 加入报告
steps: choose the test family (numeric × group or categorical × group)
read the chosen test, p-value and effect size
serves_tasks: Compare a continuous outcome across groups with an automatically chosen test
Test association between two categorical variables

features.name: Correlation heatmap with pairwise drill-down
features.general: Select a set of numeric variables to get a correlation-matrix heatmap, then pick any two for a detailed correlation with an auto / Pearson / Spearman choice, r, R², p and a scatter plot with fit
features.specific: 统计推断 → 相关分析: 相关系数热图 multiselect plus heatmap, 两变量相关分析 X/Y selects, 方法 radio (auto / pearson / spearman), result cards and scatter plot
steps: pick the variables for the heatmap
choose the X and Y variables
switch the method between auto, Pearson and Spearman
read r and p and inspect the scatter plot

features.name: Rater/method agreement analysis (Kappa / ICC / Bland-Altman)
features.general: Choose two columns measuring the same thing and an agreement type: weighted or unweighted Kappa with a cross-table for categories, ICC for numbers, or a Bland-Altman plot with bias and limits of agreement and a histogram of differences
features.specific: 统计推断 → 一致性分析: 分析类型 radio, 评估者/方法 1 and 2 (测量 1/2) selects, 加权方式, Kappa cards with 交叉表, and the Bland-Altman figure (shown in this run only with unrelated demo columns)
steps: read Kappa/ICC or the Bland-Altman limits
serves_tasks: Assess agreement between two raters or methods

features.name: Multiple-testing p-value corrector
features.general: Paste a list of p-values, pick a correction method and α, and see the adjusted p-values with a flag on each test whose conclusion changed
features.specific: 统计推断 → 多重比较校正: 校正对象 radio (p-value list / Tukey HSD), p 值列表 textarea, 校正方法 (FDR Benjamini–Hochberg and others), 显著性水平 α, 🔍 执行校正, the result table with 结论变化, and a warning banner
steps: read the adjusted p-values and the changed conclusions
serves_tasks: Correct a set of p-values for multiple testing

features.name: Logistic risk model with ROC cut-offs, calibration, DCA and nomogram
features.general: Choose a binary outcome, predictors and a test-split fraction, fit the model, then judge it with an OR table, goodness of fit, ROC with three optimal-threshold rules, a calibration curve, a decision curve and a nomogram
features.specific: 预测建模 → Logistic 回归: 结局变量 / 预测变量 / 测试集比例 slider, 🚀 运行, then 模型评价 cards (AUC train/test), 回归系数表, VIF, Hosmer-Lemeshow, ROC 曲线, 最佳截断值 table (约登指数 / 平衡点 / 离左上角最近), 校准曲线, 决策曲线分析 and 列线图
steps: read the coefficients, AUC and cut-off table
inspect the calibration curve, DCA and nomogram
serves_tasks: Fit a binary-outcome risk model and evaluate discrimination, calibration and clinical usefulness

features.name: Cox survival model with Kaplan-Meier curve
features.general: Choose a follow-up time column, an event column and covariates, fit a proportional-hazards model, and read hazard ratios, the C-index and a KM survival curve
features.specific: 预测建模 → Cox 生存回归: 生存时间列 / 事件列 / 预测变量, 🚀 运行 Cox 回归, then 模型评价 cards (n, events, C-index, AIC), Cox 回归系数表 (HR and CI) and KM生存曲线
steps: read the HRs, C-index and KM curve

features.name: Propensity score matching with balance diagnostics
features.general: Choose treatment, outcome and covariates, set a caliper and matching ratio, match, then check overlap and covariate balance before and after matching and read the matched effect estimate
features.specific: 论文辅助 → 倾向性评分匹配（PSM）: 处理变量 / 结局变量 / 协变量, 卡尺（SD） slider, 匹配比例, 🚀 运行 PSM, then 匹配概览 (146/154 to 84 pairs, PS AUC), McNemar effect test, SMD warning, PS histograms before and after, the Love plot and 加入报告
steps: check the PS overlap and the Love-plot SMDs
serves_tasks: Balance treated and control groups by propensity score matching

features.name: Subgroup effect forest plot
features.general: Choose an outcome, a treatment and a stratifying variable to get per-stratum effect estimates with CIs, shown as a table and a forest plot
features.specific: 论文辅助 → 亚组分析森林图: 结局变量 / 处理变量 / 亚组变量, 🚀 运行亚组分析, the per-subgroup OR table and the 森林图
steps: run the analysis and read the OR per stratum on the forest plot
serves_tasks: Check whether a treatment effect differs across subgroups

features.name: Report basket with multi-format export
features.general: Results are sent to a collection basket on purpose; at export time you pick which collected sections to include, the language and title, choose Word, Excel or a figure ZIP, and generate the file. Sections added late are not ticked for export automatically
features.specific: Each module's 📥 加入报告 button feeds the 报告导出 tab: 当前已收集 N 个分析章节, 分析台账, 报告语言 (中文/English), 报告标题, 要导出的章节 multiselect, 投稿规格, 导出格式 (Word 三线表 / Excel / 300 dpi PNG+TIFF ZIP), 📥 生成导出文件 (here 6 sections, 289 KB) → 💾 下载 DOCX, and 查看 / 清理已收集章节. The added methods paragraph raised the ledger count but did not appear in 要导出的章节 (screens/104.webp)
steps: press 加入报告 in each analysis you want reported
open the export tab and tick the sections, including any added later
serves_tasks: Export the collected results as a Word document

features.name: Auto-drafted methods paragraph
features.general: Get a methods summary built only from the processing and analysis steps actually performed in the session (sample size, missing-data handling, outlier handling, classes of methods used) and send it to the report
features.specific: 报告导出 → 📝 方法学段落（自动汇总）: summary table (样本量, MICE with Rubin pooling, 异常值保留, method classes) and 📥 把方法学段落加入报告

open the methods expander and read the summary table
add the paragraph to the report
tick it in the export section list before generating
serves_tasks: Add an automatically drafted methods paragraph that lists the processing steps actually performed

features.name: SPC control chart
features.general: Pick a monitored measure, an optional denominator and an optional time label; the tool chooses or lets you choose an I-MR, P or U chart and draws centre and control limits, marking out-of-control points

choose the chart type or leave it on auto
serves_tasks: Draw a statistical process control chart and flag out-of-control points
